transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you're here. What brings you into the clinic today?

I just don’t care about my painting or the garden anymore, and the things I used to look forward to feel like a burden. I don't know what's happened to me, but I just can't seem to find any joy in them anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way, and was there a specific stressful event or change in your life that seemed to trigger it?

This heavy, low feeling has been hanging over me for about three months now, following a very busy spell that started about four months ago. It really began after a stressful year of taking on more and more caregiving for my husband's worsening heart and mobility issues, which left me with very little sleep. It just completely disrupted our normal routine and wore me down.
Have you ever experienced a similar period of low mood or loss of interest like this at any other point in your life, or is this the first time?
No, I've never really experienced anything like this before in my life. This is the first time I've ever felt so completely low and drained.
Along with feeling low and losing interest, have you also been experiencing feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt?
No, I haven't really experienced feelings of worthlessness or guilt. I'm just mostly feeling very empty and drained of any interest.
Have you found it harder than usual to concentrate, focus on daily tasks, or make decisions lately?

Yes, it's been so hard to focus or make even the simplest decisions lately. I'll just stare at the calendar or my husband's pill organizer, and my mind either goes completely blank or starts spinning. I get so overwhelmed that I can't make up my mind, so I end up doing nothing at all.
During this difficult time, have you had any thoughts of harming yourself, or felt that life is no longer worth living?

No, I haven't had any thoughts of harming myself, and I don't feel like life isn't worth living. Even though I've been feeling so low, tired, and completely uninterested in things lately, I've never thought about doing something like that.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight recently, such as eating much less or more than usual?

Yes, I really have. Eating feels like a chore now, and I constantly have to remind myself to do it. My daughter has even noticed that my clothes are hanging much looser on me than they did a couple of months ago.
Are these feelings of being low, drained, and uninterested present nearly every day for most of the day, or do they tend to come and go?

Yes, they are constant and present nearly every day, pretty much all day long. This heavy cloud has been hanging over me continuously for the past three months, ever since I crashed after that busy spell in the spring. It just doesn't seem to lift at all.
How has your sleep been over these past three months? Have you been having trouble falling or staying asleep, or perhaps sleeping much more than usual?

I'm not quite sure about my actual sleep patterns over the last three months. I spend a lot of time lying down because I feel constantly bone-tired and exhausted, but I haven't really paid attention to whether I'm sleeping too much or having trouble falling asleep.
Have you or your family members noticed that you are moving, speaking, or thinking much more slowly than usual, or perhaps that you feel unusually restless and unable to sit still?

Yes, I've noticed both of those extremes. Currently, I feel incredibly slowed down, shuffling around the house like I'm walking through molasses, and my mind often goes blank when I try to make simple decisions. But a few weeks ago during that high spell, I was extremely restless, buzzing around, pacing, and unable to sit still long enough to finish anything.
During that 'high spell' you mentioned, did you feel unusually energetic, hyperactive, or irritable, or notice you needed much less sleep than usual?

Yes, I felt extremely revved up and energetic, but also very touchy and quick to snap at my daughter. I felt like I had endless energy to race around doing things at the community center, and at night my mind would spin with so many ideas that I couldn't sleep. It was like I just couldn't switch my brain off.
How long did that 'high spell' where you felt extremely energetic, restless, and had racing thoughts last?

That high spell lasted for several weeks—about a month—back in the spring. After that period of being so wound up, I crashed into this low, heavy feeling that has been going on for about three months now.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with a current major depressive episode of three months' duration, characterized by depressed mood, anhedonia, fatigue, decreased appetite with weight loss, psychomotor retardation, and cognitive difficulties. Crucially, this episode was immediately preceded by a distinct, month-long period in the spring of elevated energy, irritability, decreased need for sleep, racing thoughts, and psychomotor agitation. This history of a manic or hypomanic episode followed by a depressive episode meets the diagnostic criteria for Bipolar Affective Disorder (ICD-10: F31).
